title: accept_candidate returns full run context instead of bounded result
description: The accept_candidate tool returns a full rendered run prompt (including role, spec, skill, and rubrics) with a new run_id and run_file_path, as if it calls start_run internally. Per its description it should read the signal catalogue entry, set status to 'resolved' with a resolved_at timestamp, update the signal index, and emit a signal.resolved event — returning a short confirmation string. The actual output is ~90 KB across 860 lines, forcing the agent to use an external Read tool to consume the result and creating a spurious nested run session (run_id: dbad8c70).
proposed_resolution: Audit accept_candidate.rs to remove any start_run or prompt-rendering invocation. The tool should perform bounded file operations only: read the signal JSON, update status to 'resolved' with a resolved_at timestamp, write back, update the signal index row, and write the .moeb/events/<signal_id>.resolved.event.json file. Return a short confirmation string such as '{"accepted": true, "signal_id": "<id>", "status": "resolved"}'.
